_label: S011 Part III: an explicit disposition for EVERY ModelLake specimen. The registry is the authority for identity; no specimen is invisible.
_evidence: Grounded in this campaign's measurements -- census, 45 discovery passes, the final sweep, the working-LM tier, the small-body and specialist cohorts. Specimens with weaker evidence say so and carry a provisional disposition rather than a fabricated one.

Dream-org--Dream-v0-Instruct-7B@05334cb9.basis: Masked diffusion confirmed from bundled source. The steps-vs-quality tradeoff is the open efficiency question for this family.

GSAI-ML--iLLaDA-8B-Base@a1b5b5f8a31a.basis: Second diffusion LM; generation loop NOT bundled (honest gap). Origin of the tied-embedding duplication finding.

HuggingFaceTB--SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct@48.basis: Vision-language, 95.5% in one backbone; supports the single-organ rule.

LiquidAI--LFM2-24B-A2B@a3bbacd91a67.basis: Triple hybrid conv+attention+MoE, 9.76% active. Richest architecture surveyed; corrected the LFM2 family rule.

LiquidAI--LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct@0f604ada3.basis: 1.17B conv/attention hybrid at 128k context -- 15x the incumbent's ceiling.

LiquidAI--LFM2.5-2.6B-Base@c57bdaed1ef1.basis: Cheapest long context measured anywhere: 60 KiB/token, 8 of 30 layers attention. A5's hybrid-ratio rule paying off directly.

Qwen--Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct@495f39366efe.basis: 72.71B dense, the largest dense body; a scale reference for the density/redundancy law.

Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B@c1899de289a0.basis: The full Odyssey chain ran here: 28+7 Gravity configs, NX built and proven parentless, Odyssey III 4/4, ladder PROVEN_UNABLE with a measured mechanism. Not a Resident (degrades worst on code).

Qwen--Qwen3-14B@40c069824f42.basis: 14.77B dense, 40k context; the dense mid-tier reference.

Qwen--Qwen3-30B-A3B@ad44e777bcd1.basis: O005. 30.53B/3.35B active, 11%. Expert-organ rules apply directly; the reference MoE for this campaign.

Qwen--Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507@cdbee75f17c.basis: Cheapest credible challenger: 4.02B, 262k context, 7.5GiB. Resources-first candidate.

Qwen--Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct@b2cff.basis: Ranked #1 on anatomy for HCLI's job: MoE 3.35B active, code-specialised, 262k context. Gravity search design already written. Gated on G004/G005.

Qwen--Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B@97b0c614be4d.basis: An embedding model: scores text, cannot generate or call tools, so it CANNOT be a Resident. Retained only as a possible independent calibrator.

Qwen--Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct@9c4b90e1.basis: O006. Same MoE topology plus vision; origin of the NX-gather accounting.

Qwen--Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct@0c351dd01ed8.basis: Config read only; not used in a receipt. Dominated by the 30B-A3B VL body already sealed as O006.

Qwen--Qwen3.8-Flash-Next@34567a4712bc.basis: 180B/59.1B active -- 32.8%, the NEGATIVE PATIENT that refuted the gather rule's top-k form and forced the expert-mass refinement.

RWKV--RWKV7-13.3B-20260805@64ffe5934178.basis: Matrix-valued state linear recurrence, a genuinely distinct family; exact-byte anatomy done.

Wan-AI--Wan2.2-T2V-A14B@c8c270b13ee0.basis: Text-to-video, 28.58B at F32 across high/low noise models; the largest F32 body measured.

ai21labs--AI21-Jamba2-3B@525c6c8e1d9f.basis: Config-only read for the A5 transfer test; hybrid SSM family confirmation.

allenai--Olmo-3-1025-7B@a81bae42db39.basis: NO GQA at all (32/32 KV heads) -- 512 KiB/token, the most expensive body to serve in the tier.

answerdotai--ModernBERT-large@45bb4654a4.basis: Encoder-only; local/global attention heterogeneity that costs ZERO bytes -- the methodological correction.

arcinstitute--evo2_40b@d529aa57c307.basis: Split .pt parts; UNMEASURABLE statically. Needs a metadata-only reader before any judgement.

arcinstitute--evo2_7b@bda0089f9258.basis: Genomic/DNA, non-language. Light pass only (.pt format); 1M-token training context is the architectural point.

bigcode--starcoder2-7b@bb9afde76d79.basis: Code-specialised but only 16k context; dominated by Qwen3-Coder on the axis that matters for HCLI.

boltz-community--boltz-2@6fdef46d763f.basis: Protein structure; non-standard config, skipped by the census glob. Needs a dedicated reader.

deepseek-ai--DeepSeek-V4-Flash@60d8d7077.basis: 158.07B / 11.01B active at 1.01 bytes/param (F8_E8M0 scales + I8 payload). Already sub-bf16 at rest.

depth-anything--Depth-Anything-V2-Large-.basis: Monocular depth; 90.8% backbone / 0.1% head -- the most extreme head/backbone split measured.

facebook--musicgen-large@15ccdc920998.basis: Generative audio, three sub-models incl. a full codec. Ships legacy pickle; the live candidate to BREAK the single-organ rule.

facebook--sam2.1-hiera-large@665f8e2ad61.basis: Vision/video segmentation; 94.8% of params in one backbone. Origin of R-specialist-body-single-organ.

facebook--vjepa2-vitg-fpc64-256@875c192b.basis: Self-supervised video, 97.8% encoder. Predictive rather than generative.

google--flan-t5-large@0613663d0d48.basis: 0.78B at 4.00 bytes/param F32 -- an older encoder-decoder, dominated on every axis by Whisper for enc-dec science.

google--timesfm-2.0-500m-pytorch@dc24437.basis: Numeric time-series forecasting -- the most domain-distant specimen in the lake.

ibm-granite--granite-4.0-h-micro@d5f01a3.basis: Config-only read for the A5 SSM-crossover transfer test; rule TRANSFERRED UNCHANGED.

ibm-granite--granite-4.0-h-tiny@791e0d3d.basis: Granite hybrid MoE, 6.94B; hybrid-family data point.

kyutai--moshika-pytorch-bf16@a49141e28b3.basis: Streaming audio; non-standard layout with a small consolidated file alongside shards.

lerobot--pi0_base@25c379b52ba2.basis: VLA robot control via flow matching; dual Gemma towers. Out of domain for HCLI, high architecture diversity.

microsoft--Phi-4-mini-instruct@cfbefacb9.basis: 3.84B, 131k context, smallest fast executor in the tier.

microsoft--bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16@27668.basis: bf16 expansion of the ternary body; its value is as the comparison arm that made the 4-per-byte packing provable.

microsoft--bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T@04c3b9ad93.basis: Natively ternary; complete-system EBPW 3.91 against a '1.58-bit' name. The external benchmark for the byte-accounting law.

mistralai--Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruc.basis: 24.01B after correcting a duplicate-export double count that read 48B. 44.72 GiB of the specimen is redundant.

moonshotai--Kimi-K3@9f62e4e9fffb.basis: 1503.65B / 83.02B active at 1.04 bytes/param, 96.2% expert mass. The strongest gather candidate in the lake; needs GPU.

moonshotai--Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct.basis: Linear-attention hybrid; A5 rule TRANSFERRED WITH RETUNING (=O007).

moonshotai--Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct@398eede.basis: O003 SEALED, 16.0 BPW / 51.6 TPS measured. Origin of the routing-skew and gather rule tests.

nvidia--audio-flamingo-3@ee26c5842398.basis: Audio-language, 8.43B across llm/ + sound_tower/ subdirectories -- the specimen that exposed the recursive-glob trap.

openai--whisper-large-v3-turbo@41f01f3fe.basis: First encoder-decoder; 32:4 layer asymmetry means the small organ dominates latency.

state-spaces--mamba3-mimo-1.5b@bc6b5d0f7.basis: MIMO sibling to siso, ships legacy .bin so static measurement is blocked; needs a torch metadata reader.

state-spaces--mamba3-siso-1.5b@5cfc72154.basis: Pure SSM, zero attention. Conv-free state accounting; corrected an unverified d_conv assumption.

tencent--HunyuanVideo@6204ad6aea1a.basis: Video generation; config.json unparseable (non-JSON). Needs a dedicated reader.

thinkingmachines--Inkling-Small@8cc5877b.basis: 263.73B / 12.07B active, 4.6% -- the sparsest active fraction measured. Ships a consolidated copy alongside shards.

tiiuae--Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct@41e72f27ef.basis: O001 SEALED. Origin of R-ssm-state-vs-kv-crossover; hybrid Mamba2+attention.

windowsxp811203--Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Abli.basis: Abliterated twin, identical anatomy. Value is as a matched pair for behavioural comparison, not for Gravity.

zai-org--GLM-4.5-Air@a24ceef6ce4f.basis: 110.47B / 14.96B active, 92.2% expert mass -- gather is nearly the whole battle.

zai-org--GLM-5.3-Flash@04c4e9e95c5d.basis: 321.34B / 18.33B active at 1.02 bytes/param, natively FP8. EBPW baseline must be set from its real dtype mix.
